This is an easy add on to almost any meal.

Ingredients

Potatoes

Any kind of oil

Salt and Pepper

  • Preheat your oven to 425F
  • Get out a cookie sheet, a cutting board and a nice sized knife.
  • Wash your taters and take each one and cut it in half.
  • Lay the cut side down and cut each half into slices about an 1/8 of an inch thick and transfer to the cookie sheet.
  • Cut up the rest of your taters until the cookie sheet is filled.
  • Dump 4 Tablespoons of oil over the top and Salt and Pepper them heavily.
  • Toss them around in the pan until they are nice and coated.
  • Put the pan in the middle rack of your oven, set a timer for 15 mins.
  • Once your timer hits pull them out and turn them over
  • Set your timer for another 15 mins and turn them again and throw them back in.
  • Cook for a final 15 min, and pull them out. And they should be done!
  • Note that you can cook for a few extra mins if you want crispier fries.
